meta.title: Why did this answer go wrong?
meta.subtitle: Triage one failed question at a time. Each branch names the check, each leaf the usual fix.

nodes.label: Should it have refused?
nodes.sublabel: the answer is not in the documents

nodes.label: Yes, but it answered: refusal failure
nodes.sublabel: fix the prompt: allow only the context, give an exact refusal sentence

nodes.label: No: was the evidence retrieved?
nodes.sublabel: check the retrieved chunks, not the answer

nodes.label: Not retrieved: retrieval failure
nodes.sublabel: is the file indexed? chunk size, k, hybrid search, metadata

nodes.label: Retrieved, still wrong: generation failure
nodes.sublabel: prompt rules, conflicting versions, model choice
